title: Default Top Perspective Two Window Layout
description: Make puzzle 3d and aggregator use a two-window layout by default: Top (left 1/3), Perspective (right 2/3). Honor instanceId and templateId from app default layouts so each pane seeds the correct projection.
summary: Completed the Top/Perspective 3D window follow-up by binding middle-button drag directly to pan for every projection, so plan/orthographic windows no longer require Shift. Added a real Three.js OrbitControls regression test proving an unmodified middle drag moves the plan target while preserving the camera offset (pan, not orbit). Verified the live Puzzle 3D React preview loads both Top and Perspective windows without console warnings/errors; infinite-world-r3f quick suite passes 102/102.
